subject: MOVE statement
notes: kb/Work/PB427.md - LANDED. CheckStrongMove implements BOTH halves of SR2, and its 'same type' is now 8.5.3.1's, not a stand-in. 'Identifier-1 shall be SPECIFIED': a non-field sending operand yields sender==null and errors, so a literal sender is rejected (measured: MOVE "123456" TO P1 -> COBOL1533) and so is a FUNCTION sender (measured -> 1533). 'Described as a group item of the SAME type': StrongTypeModel.SameType is 8.5.3.1's clause verbatim - 'Two typed items are of the same type when: (1) the items are described with TYPE clauses that reference equivalent type declarations; or (2) the items are described as subordinate items in equivalent type declarations, starting at the same relative byte or bit position and having the same length in bytes or bits' - over EquivalentTypeDeclarations, which is the clause's own equivalence relation (same type-name, same presence or absence of EXTERNAL and STRONG, corresponding elementary items at the same relative position and length, each pair carrying the same ALIGNED / BLANK WHEN ZERO / DYNAMIC LENGTH / JUSTIFIED / PICTURE / SIGN / SYNCHRONIZED / USAGE clauses). Positions come from BitLayout.StartBitWithin, the ONE 8.5.1.6.3 cursor walk, so bit-bearing declarations are measured by the same law as their storage; the PICTURE/SIGN/USAGE conjunct is PicInfo's own record equality, so a later analysis axis is covered by construction rather than by a member list. THE TWO DEFECTS THE PRIOR PARTIAL RECORDED ARE BOTH CLOSED, EACH RE-MEASURED ON THE BUILT cobol.exe BEFORE AND AFTER. (a) FALSE ADMISSION: an outer program's '01 SHAPE-T TYPEDEF STRONG. 05 SA PIC X(6).' against a contained program's own '01 SHAPE-T TYPEDEF STRONG. 05 SB PIC 9(3). 05 SC PIC 9(3).' - before: MOVE OUTER-X TO INNER-Y compiled clean and ran, printing SB=[ABC] SC=[DEF] into two PIC 9(3) items; after: COBOL1533, because the declarations share only a NAME (conformance:cases/14.9.25-MOVE/pb427-same-type-nonequivalent-declarations, conformance-test:TypedefStrongTests.MoveNonEquivalentSameNamedDeclarations_Rejected1533). (b) FALSE REJECTION: '01 NEST-T TYPEDEF STRONG. 05 OUTERG. 10 INNERG. 15 LEAFX PIC X(4).' with MOVE OUTERG OF N1 TO INNERG OF N2 - before: rc=70 COBOL1533; after: accepted and runs (both subordinate items start at relative bit 0 and are 32 bits long, which is alternative 2 exactly) (conformance:cases/14.8.2.2-Group-items/pb427_same_type_by_position leg A, conformance-test:TypedefStrongTests.MoveSameOffsetDifferentlyNamedSubgroups_Accepted). The two criteria are now told apart by a PAIR of witnesses: paths differ and positions agree -> legal (MoveSameOffsetDifferentlyNamedSubgroups_Accepted); paths agree and positions differ -> refused (MoveSamePathDifferentPosition_Rejected1533, two equivalent declarations whose grouping differs so that G spans bits 0-31 in one and 16-31 in the other). Over-rejection is guarded in the same set: MoveEquivalentSameNamedDeclarationsAcrossElements_Accepted proves two source elements declaring EQUIVALENT same-named types still describe items of the same type, so the fix refuses the non-equivalent pair without refusing the equivalent one, and MoveSameLayoutDifferentPicture_Rejected1533 isolates the PICTURE conjunct (identical name, strength, layout, positions and lengths; X(3) against 9(3)). The mainline stays correct: a different strong type, a structurally identical UNTYPED group, a literal sender and a FUNCTION sender are all 1533, and IsStrongGroup still restricts the gate to GROUP receivers per 8.5.3.3 ('The only kind of items that may be strongly typed are group items'), so an elementary leaf subordinate to a strong record keeps its unrestricted field MOVE. EDITIONS: STRONG TYPEDEF is a 2002 introduction (ConstructRegistry typedef-def-2002), so the rule has no 85 surface - conformance:cases/14.9.25-MOVE/pb427-same-type-below-2002 pins the floor (COBOL0900 at 85). 8.5.3.1's currency-symbol and DECIMAL-POINT IS COMMA exceptions (GR-8.5.3.1-1 / -2) are not witnessed HERE and deliberately so: 12.3.3 SR1 forbids a contained program its own CONFIGURATION SECTION (measured: COBOL1643), so two type declarations reachable by one compile-time same-type test always share one CURRENCY SIGN and one DECIMAL-POINT setting - those exceptions are observable only between separately compiled elements sharing an EXTERNAL strongly-typed record, where 14.8.1 makes the conformance a RUNTIME check. The predicate implements them regardless (the analysis PicInfo carries is currency-canonicalized and decimal-point-resolved), and the two rows stay for the adjudication lane. retired-witness: src/Cobol.Net.Compiler/Binding/Validation/StatementValidation.cs#CheckStrongMove (kb/Work PB878 deleted StatementValidation.CheckStrongMove; SR2 is MoveTable16.StrongGroupRefusal, first link of the Validity chain, framed as COBOL1533 by MoveBinder.MoveCategoryLegality)
